slides.hook: if i started the gym today, this is exactly what i'd do

slides.title: 1. one plan. no switching.
slides.text: 4 days a week: upper, lower, rest, upper, lower.

slides.title: 2. start on machines
slides.text: same setup every time, so this week compares to last week.

slides.title: 3. 2 working sets per exercise
slides.text: 4–8 clean reps each. warm up as needed. warm-ups don't count.

slides.title: 4. rest 2–3 minutes
slides.text: so your second set is a real one.

slides.title: 5. write it down
slides.text: weight and reps for every working set. next time, beat it.

slides.label: real tip
slides.text: know what you're training and what to beat before you walk in.
